_readme: Everyone on the site. Edit this, then run python tools/build.py. Fields: id (the old ?p= slug, kept so team-member.html?p=... links still land), slug (the page address, team/<slug>), name, role, pronouns (optional), tagline and about (the person's own words: never rewrite them; about is a list of paragraphs and may hold links, written as the other person's slug e.g. 'lewis-mennim.html', which the build turns into /team/lewis-mennim), favourite ('turtle' or 'seagull': which of the two heroes they back, shown as Team Turtle or Team Seagull), socials (list of {label, url}), status (talent pool only: 'active' or 'former'), founder (true for the three founders), photo (a file in source/team), crop (optional [left, top, width] as fractions of the photo, for the 4:5 portrait tools/images.py cuts; leave it out to take the full width from the top), knowsAbout (optional, for search engines), metaDescription (optional search snippet, when the first sentence of about will not do). A person with no about text is treated as unfinished: no profile link, no page.

team.name: Lewis Mennim
about: Turtle-obsessed CEO. I founded the studio back in 2025, and I'll do anything to make it successful.
Before Shiverbug I managed a bar and restaurant, which turns out to be decent training for running a games studio: tight margins, a busy team, and everyone wanting something at once.
The first game I remember playing was Spyro: Year of the Dragon, and I spent ages in the skateboard levels. Hence the tattoo.

team.name: Ryan Hughes
team.tagline: The one that always has to say no
about: Video games became so much more than just a hobby for me very early on. There's just no other medium like it. One day you're playing a deeply gripping interactive story, the next you're locked into tight, super engaging gameplay mechanics, or even just relaxing with a simple incremental game that scratches that exact spot in the monkey brain where "number go up." Being in a position where we get to create our own games at Shiverbug is such a privilege, and I love being able to give other players those same thrilling, memorable experiences.

Growing up, though, I played Call of Duty: Zombies almost every single day. I was completely fascinated by a bonus mode that almost didn't even make the cut in World at War. On the surface it looks simple: wave after wave of zombies, each one longer than the last, and you buy weapons off the wall or gamble on the Mystery Box to stay ahead of them.

But once you look a little deeper, you realise just how much is packed under the surface. There's a massive, universe-spanning storyline hidden behind intricate main quest Easter eggs, radio logs, and cryptic ciphers, some of which literally took the community over ten years to solve. Balancing that deep puzzle-solving with having to constantly adapt your survival strategy on the fly just to make it to the next round on the leaderboards was pure magic, and it's a huge reason I view game design the way I do today.

team.name: Garrett Windus
about: Before Lewis reached out about starting a studio, I was a Realistic Vehicle artist and had to quickly adapt to making stylised environments.
My favourite games are Minecraft and Terraria.
team.metaDescription: Garrett Windus - 3D Artist and co-founder at Shiverbug Studios. A realistic vehicle artist who switched to building stylised environments.

team.name: Sarah Childs
team.tagline: Never give up on a dream because of the time it takes. The time will pass anyway.
about: Specialist in fantasy, historical and RPG character designs that express gameplay mechanics and world-building through research-informed visuals. I love learning about the world and people around me, and expressing their stories through my art. I'm inspired by games that combine narrative, music, and art to create immersive worlds such as Zelda OOT, Final Fantasy X, and Kingdom Come: Deliverance.

Over 10 years of professional art experience. First Class Honours Graduate in Concept Art BA at Teesside University. Awarded The Leni Oglesby Prize and Dean's Award for Best Graduating Student 2025. Twice winner of Best in Concept Art at Expo Tees. Graduate of David Ko's Riot Games Stylized Character Mentorship. Creator of The Chronicles of Gyzra graphic novels. In May 2026, I joined Shiverbug Studios to help bring their characters to life!
team.metaDescription: Sarah Childs - Character Concept Artist at Shiverbug Studios. Fantasy, historical and RPG character design driven by research and world-building.

team.name: Megan Nicol
team.tagline: The art of not being ready and doing it anyway will take you very far
about: I'm a creative 2D artist who specialises in Character and Creature design. I mostly use Photoshop and Procreate when doing initial sketch ideas.

I am heavily inspired by animals and folklore from different cultures and love to travel to get more inspiration, especially when I can put a fantasy twist into the design thanks to my love of movies, books, and games. Some of my favourites for example are Princess Mononoke, The Chronicles of Narnia, Elden Ring, soulframe and The Shepherd King duology!

team.name: Charlie Pelling
about: I'm an aspiring Narrative Designer with a passion for creating immersive storytelling and loveable characters for people to enjoy. I've always loved playing through games and being left with a bittersweet feeling. That's how you know a game is great.
My love for narrative began when I first played The Walking Dead Telltale series and realised how much one decision could spin a story and impact the future of your journey.
At Shiverbug I write the voice lines for our characters, move the narrative forward and make the journey worth experiencing.
Some of my all time favourite games are Silent Hill 2/3, Red Dead Redemption 1/2 and Cyberpunk 2077.
team.metaDescription: Charlie Pelling - Narrative Designer at Shiverbug Studios. Narrative designer focused on immersive storytelling and characters players remember.

team.name: Connor Milburn
about: I'm a dedicated 3D Artist who likes to specialise in Environment Art and Props, I primarily use Blender, ZBrush, the Substance Suite, Unreal Engine and now Unity. One of my favourite things about being a 3D Artist is that I get to create awesome models and environments for games, it's just awe-inspiring seeing worlds come to life. As part of this, I love to make modular assets as a root back to my love for architecture. Whether it's an old Victorian building with a beautiful façade or a modern office building with interesting shapes, my interest will always be piqued.

Also, as I'm part of the game development world, I must have a favourite kind of game... well I love loads of games but growing up I was always hooked on the Assassin's Creed franchise, and well basically any game released by Ubisoft (Watch Dogs, Rainbow 6).
team.metaDescription: Connor Milburn - 3D Artist at Shiverbug Studios. Environment and prop artist working in Blender, ZBrush, the Substance Suite, Unreal Engine and Unity.

team.name: Charlie Ashall
about: I'm a level designer that works in Unreal and Unity. I graduated from Teesside University in July 2025 with First Class Honours in Game Design, and am currently studying a masters in Game Design. I joined Shiverbug in May of 2026 as a level designer.

Some of my favourite games are Sonic X Shadow Generations, Resident Evil and Hades 1/2. My favourite part of games is the level design and creating different worlds and levels for players to explore and be guided through.
Outside of games, I also like to take part in the One Piece TCG (a revolutionary Army player) and explore different pieces of media.

team.name: Oliver Neal
about: I'm a games developer working in Unity and C#. I graduated from Teesside University in July 2026 with First Class Honours in BSc (Hons) Games Development, where my final-year project won the Best Games Programming award, and I joined Shiverbug Studios as a gameplay programmer straight after.
At Shiverbug I write the gameplay: player systems, AI, and the general plumbing that makes the game feel good to play. I also built this website, and I co-run our social media with Madi Freck.
I love automation games, tactical shooters like Valorant, and a good co-op session. Beyond playing them, I really enjoy game design itself and thinking about what makes games fun.

team.name: Martin Wilkinson
team.tagline: A great world invites players to explore.
about: I've been passionate about games for as long as I can remember, and they've always inspired me to create worlds of my own. I specialise in environment art, with a particular love for stylised games, strong silhouettes, and creating places that players enjoy exploring.
team.metaDescription: Martin Wilkinson - 3D Artist at Shiverbug Studios. Environment artist drawn to stylised games, strong silhouettes and places worth exploring.

team.name: Kyle Kerr
about: Creating worlds and experiences has been my passion for over 10 years, from building custom maps in Halo: Reach's Forge World to shipping Fallout 76: Burning Springs as a placement level designer in 2025, before graduating from Teesside University in July 2026.
I'm a strong believer that video games can be so much more than something to pass the time. Stories, memories and lessons are all purposely intertwined into the games we create.

Lately I've been playing a lot of Elden Ring Nightreign, which really resonates with what I aim to convey in my own work: teaching the player that failure is life's greatest teacher. It forces you to adapt to enemy movement and attack patterns, and rewards you for delving into the characters' backstories to earn their specific relics.

Outside of gaming I enjoy building, painting and playing Warhammer on the tabletop, where a group of close friends and I meet up to show off our painting skills, share tips and tricks, and try to best one another at strategy. I also get out into nature when I can: my most recent hike ran over six hours in Germany, where we visited a castle and finished the day with a well-deserved ice cream.
team.metaDescription: Kyle Kerr - Level Designer at Shiverbug Studios. Shipped Fallout 76: Burning Springs on placement, and a Teesside University graduate.

talent.name: Josh Cairns
talent.tagline: Maybe a little autistic about Dinosaurs
about: I'm Josh, a stylised 3D Environment Artist specialising in Blender, ZBrush, Substance Painter, Unreal Engine, and with a limited knowledge of Unity. I've been passionate about games for as long as I can remember; games like Crash Bandicoot, Ratchet and Clank and Shadow of the Colossus were some of my favourite games growing up, all of them with absolutely breath-taking environments that I always look to for inspiration.

One of my favourite things about being a 3D Artist is the entire development process. I find it incredibly satisfying going from a simple blockout to a complete 3D model within a game engine. It provides a sense of pride and accomplishment (I am not quoting EA, don't dig into it) seeing how far a model can come along, and for me that goes for everything I model. I go into each development with the same passion and drive: no matter how big or small the asset is, I'll make sure it's PERFECT.
Outside of games I'm a massive nerd for practically everything, particularly Dinosaurs, DC and Star Wars, and I happen to be an avid football enjoyer (I use avid lightly, RAWA).
talent.metaDescription: Josh Cairns - 3D Artist in the Shiverbug Studios talent pool. A stylised environment artist working in Blender, ZBrush, Substance Painter and Unreal.

talent.name: Evan Atherton-Elphick
about: Recent graduate from Teesside University with First Class Honours, I have a passion for 3D art and creating fun, interesting, and expressive stuff! I'm always trying to improve my skills and display my ideas in the most comprehensive ways possible.
Also a big fan of cinema and games as an artform, I always stay curious!
talent.metaDescription: Evan Atherton-Elphick - Character Artist in the Shiverbug Studios talent pool. A Teesside graduate making fun, expressive characters in 3D.

talent.name: Madi Freck
about: Hello, I'm Madi Freck, a 2D Animation and Stop-motion artist from Teesside University.

I specialise in stop-motion puppet making, frame-by-frame animation and creating 2D character rigs. I'm currently using my background in graphics design to co-run Shiverbug's social media and branding with Oliver Neal.

talent.name: Nathan Hopwood
talent.tagline: Had I not been a 3D artist, I would have been an archaeologist
about: I'm a dedicated Hard Surface 3D Artist who specialises in Vehicles, Weapons and Props. I primarily use Maya, Blender, Substance Painter, Unreal Engine and Unity. One of my favourite things about being a 3D Artist is that I get to create detailed and intricate models, allowing me to prove my skills in various different ways. As a huge fan of anything automotive, I love to make tons of different vehicle projects: sometimes I choose to be as detailed as possible, and other times I allow my creativity to flow free. I like to experiment with weapons and props on the side, sometimes for a breath of fresh air or just when I want to try something else.

I'm hugely inspired by games like The Witcher 3, Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2, Assassin's Creed Black Flag, and anything history related. Whilst a lot of my artwork is mostly cars, I do have a massive passion for ancient history. I love learning about history by watching films, documentaries and podcasts, or even reading about it. I can say with confidence that had I not been a 3D artist, I would have been an archaeologist.
talent.metaDescription: Nathan Hopwood - former 3D Artist at Shiverbug Studios. A hard surface artist specialising in vehicles, weapons and props.

talent.name: Max Breeze
talent.tagline: I've always loved living in other worlds
about: I care a lot about games. I've been playing since I was 5, starting with Oddworld: Stranger's Wrath, and I've always loved living in other worlds and being able to create worlds of my own.
I do a lot of GDD work and always chip in when it comes to games. Big fan of knights, vikings and fantasy stuff.
talent.metaDescription: Max Breeze - former Character Artist at Shiverbug Studios. A character artist who has been building game worlds since Oddworld at age five.

talent.name: Aidan Hendry
talent.tagline: Always pay attention to the small things, because they're the ones that bring the magic
about: I'm a British sound designer with a First Class BA (with Hons) in Digital Music from Solent University and an MA with a distinction in Sound Design from Manchester Metropolitan University. After finishing some work on another game, I joined Shiverbug Studios as a sound designer.
I love adventure games, card games, and anything with a whimsical vibe. I am the first to point out when I recognise a sound popping up across different games or movies.
talent.metaDescription: Aidan Hendry - former Sound Designer at Shiverbug Studios. A sound designer with a First Class BA in Digital Music and an MA in Sound Design.
